upper_bound.load_bearing: The finiteness of $\mathcal C$ (hence of $P$ and the existence of $L$) rests entirely on Lemma 2 confining every prime of every minimal support to a terminal member; Lemma 1 alone only bounds minimal supports of bounded size, not all of them.
